repair: Rebuilt the regression baseline from repeated pristine runs in the offline verifier. The upstream baseline used ids without the leading '/' that this verifier's Julia testset parser emits, so every baseline test read as missing.
baseline_network_policy: Repeated pristine (empty-patch) runs in the separate verifier with enforced offline execution.
